title: AI Search Optimization
arc: Hook (who do you ask first?) > stakes (assistants quote a few sources) > guide (this is what I do) > demonstration (quoted pages, structured data, plain text) > proof (two sites) > honesty (no guarantees) > invitation (a call). Mood arc: cool dark ground until the guide arrives, then the warm orange takes over.
style: Dark charcoal ground (#0b0d10), one orange accent (#ff6b2c), crisp editorial 3D UI mock-ups and clean illustration, soft rim light, shallow depth, 16:9. Generic unbranded chat panels and browser windows. No people, no logos, no real company marks, no real text except the short words named in the prompt.

shots.vo: [curious] Quick question. When you want to know something... who do you ask first?
shots.image: A glowing empty search bar on the left and an empty chat input box on the right, a single blinking cursor floating between them, dark void, orange rim light
shots.motion: slow push in toward the gap between the two boxes, the cursor blinking

shots.vo: [warmly] More and more people ask an AI assistant.
shots.image: Three floating unbranded chat windows at different depths, each showing a question bubble and a short answer bubble as abstract grey bars, faint orange glow behind them
shots.motion: parallax: the three windows drift at different speeds

shots.vo: And it doesn't hand back ten links. It quotes... [pause] a few sources.
shots.image: One large chat answer card; above it a stack of ten faded grey link rows sliding away, and only three rows lit in orange with a small quote-mark glyph, the rest in shadow
shots.motion: the grey rows slide out of frame, the three orange rows stay and glow

shots.vo: [excited] Just a few! So here's the question. [confident] Are you one of them?
shots.image: Three lit orange source cards in a row, and a fourth empty outlined card with a pulsing question mark, a crowd of dim grey cards behind
shots.motion: the empty card pulses, slow push in

shots.vo: That's my job. It's called AI search optimization. Or GEO, if you like acronyms.
shots.image: A magnifying lens made of concentric orange rings floating over a clean web page, the page lit warm behind the lens, particles drifting in from the left
shots.motion: the lens rings expand slowly and the page brightens

shots.vo: I build pages made to be quoted. Plain answers to what your customers actually ask... in your voice.
shots.image: A clean web page mock-up where one question-and-answer block is highlighted in orange with a large quotation-mark glyph lifting off the page toward the viewer
shots.motion: the quote glyph lifts and glows, slight camera orbit

shots.vo: Then structured data, so assistants know who you are, what you offer, and where.
shots.image: Three labeled data blocks (shown only as the short words WHO, WHAT, WHERE) snapping onto the edge of a web page like puzzle pieces, orange connector lines, warm light
shots.motion: the three blocks slide in and click onto the page one after another

shots.vo: Plus plain-text versions, and an llms-dot-txt file. I run it all on my own site.
shots.image: A web page on the left and its plain-text twin on the right as simple lines of monospace text, a small file icon labeled llms.txt between them, orange thread connecting all three
shots.motion: the orange thread draws across, then the file icon pops

shots.vo: It sits on nearly twenty years of SEO. Same foundation. Clearer pages.
shots.image: A stack of solid stone blocks forming a foundation, a neat tower of web pages built on top of it, orange light along the seams, warm sunrise glow behind

shots.vo: Garage Door Science, a site I built, is gaining ground in search and AI answers. Garage Door Pro Services? Number one within three months.
shots.image: Two abstract dashboard cards side by side, each with a rising sparkline with no numbers, the right card carrying a small orange rosette badge, warm light, dark ground
shots.motion: the sparklines draw upward, the badge pops in

shots.vo: Can I promise ChatGPT will name you? No. Nobody can.
shots.image: A round GUARANTEED-style stamp shown only as an empty circular seal with a bold orange strike-through line across it, dark ground, a hand-drawn feel
shots.motion: the strike-through line slashes across the seal

shots.vo: I can make your pages clear, accurate, and easy to quote. And tell you what I'd change first.
shots.image: A clean checklist card with three ticks drawn in orange, the first line highlighted, a pen cursor ready to edit, warm light
shots.motion: the three ticks draw on one by one

shots.vo: [warmly] So let's start with a call about your business. [confident] Seth Shoultes dot com.
shots.image: A phone standing upright with a calendar slot glowing orange on its screen, a soft orb of particles forming behind it, warm light
shots.motion: slow push in as the orb forms behind the phone
